mood: Dark and precious: an obsidian arena where gold shards orbit your ship and detonate.

shape.borderStyle: 1px solid gold at 50% with a gold glow on focus

buttonStyle: Primary is a gold gradient hex-cornered button with near-black Black Ops One text; secondary is an obsidian button with a gold hairline and orange hover glow.
backdrop: Near-black ground with a faint gold hex grid and a slowly rotating ring of twelve gold shards around the title; shards only rotate, no flashing.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
